# Goal
Kaidoku round 26, attempt 1: wave 2 of two v1 waves — the falsify wave — for lane repo /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kaidoku-shokunin (reverse engineering of shipped artifacts with REA on this Linux host). Every seat attacks one thing wave 1 and the L1 produced and returns a verdict: holds, fails (with a counterexample) or could-not-evaluate. Lane-round base a0639d8e61e486e2a716ff94cddd89a73200a02c; claims frozen at c27f445e70cedbaf5300b2fd0a53e821d9b659a9 in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kaidoku-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-26/claims.json (read it first; its rules bind). Lane commits so far: 81f63f36 (C2 instrument, before receipt), ebe2cb4a (C1 evidence, entry, S079-S080, lesson, README), 46ebfd2f (C2 repair of SCORECARD owned-axes rows and SHONEN), bd0c84bc (C1 instrument, receipts), c327772653badd3b19b3954e1f8713973aa3f93e (routed fixes: SKILL.md custody note, round-25 entry correction, QUALITY row 35). The L1 will add a SCORECARD round-26 section, a LOG entry and a claim-freezes row while you work; judge committed bytes at the commit you name.
- R26-C1 depth: `python3 -I -B /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kaidoku-shokunin/tools/round-26/c1-id-identity.py --root /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kaidoku-shokunin --rev <REV>`; before 0 of 8 and entry_ok 0 at a0639d8e; after 8 of 8 and entry_ok 1 at ebe2cb4a. Table /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kaidoku-shokunin/corpus/evidence/round-26/c1/table.tsv, 24 envelopes in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kaidoku-shokunin/corpus/evidence/round-26/c1/envelopes/, runs.tsv, recompute tool /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kaidoku-shokunin/tools/round-26/recompute-ids.py. Entry /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kaidoku-shokunin/corpus/knowledge/2026-10-22-r26-native-reader-evidence-id-identity.md. Rows S079, S080 in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kaidoku-shokunin/corpus/SOURCES.md; lesson /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kaidoku-shokunin/corpus/lessons/round-26.md.
- R26-C2 calibration: `python3 -I -B /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kaidoku-shokunin/tools/round-26/c2-calibration.py --root /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kaidoku-shokunin --rev <REV>`; before 5 of 6 mismatches at a0639d8e; after 0 of 6 at 46ebfd2f.
- Wave-1 seat reports are in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kaidoku-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-26/w1/ (read them; do not repeat their work, attack the result).
# Contract
- Paths: every path is absolute. Every `Report:` trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kaidoku-shokunin - write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kaidoku-shokunin/<that path>. Write nothing else inside /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kaidoku-shokunin. Put scripts, raw output and other artifacts under /fast/scratch/hyaku/kaidoku-r26/seats/w2/<your item name>/ and list each with its sha256 in the report.
- Bounds: read-only on the lane. Never edit lane files. Never mutate the fleet repo /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin, sibling lanes, lane jj state or the lane Git index. No git add/commit/checkout/reset/stash/switch/pull/push in the lane. Never run any jj command at the fleet root /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin; in the lane, jj only read-only with --ignore-working-copy. Read-only git (show, log, ls-tree, cat-file, diff, rev-parse) is fine. Mutation and any Git write happen in a sandbox clone `git clone -q /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kaidoku-shokunin /fast/scratch/hyaku/kaidoku-r26/seats/w2/<your item name>/clone`.
- Evidence: every finding names its producing command, an exact output excerpt, exit code and UTC time; label each conclusion observation, inference or unknown. Never fabricate; an unrun check has not passed.
- Sources: open sources by ordinary means only (plain HTTP fetch, a normal reader, or a local file read); never use a headless browser or any other tool to pass a bot challenge, captcha or access control. A source you cannot open that way is unopened and supports nothing. Record URL or path, access date 2026-10-22, sha256 and a located quote of at most 25 words.
- REA: CLI only, from a bash shell that has the login environment (`GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR` and `REA_*` variables from ~/.bashrc), `TMPDIR=/fast/scratch/hyaku/kaidoku-r26/seats/w2/<your item name>/tmp npx -y rea-agents@6.5.0 <argv>`; never MCP devices; only on /usr/bin/jq and copies of it; one call at a time. Package roots (read-only): 6.5.0 /home/vgpnk/.npm/_npx/ad9a3fdbcad992c6/node_modules/rea-agents/, 6.7.0 /home/vgpnk/.npm/_npx/a1722018f28f9df2/node_modules/rea-agents/.
- Tooling: you may install or upgrade tools that help the task - read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first, use official channels, and record tool, version, channel and reason in your report. All pacman transactions are PAUSED host-wide: install only via `uv tool`, `uv venv` + `uv pip`, `npx`, or an official binary in ~/.local/bin; never -Sy, -Syu, -U, -R, downgrade, or restart a host service.
- You are a leaf: no delegation, no background jobs, never message agent://all. Finish within 30 minutes. Keep the report under 100 lines. Write plain English with spaced words, no run-together tokens.

items.name: RerunC1Counter
items.prompt:
# Target
R26-C1 counting command re-run.
# Work
Run the C1 counter at a0639d8e61e486e2a716ff94cddd89a73200a02c, c27f445e70cedbaf5300b2fd0a53e821d9b659a9, ebe2cb4aff1aea6f45e8bb5583662717ea61c0bb and c327772653badd3b19b3954e1f8713973aa3f93e; run `--selftest`; compare the instrument sha256 at each later commit with 11c274220fb5df41ef4467f595cf20a02c8e24240e37c6639308e2816fa918fa.
# Acceptance
Outputs and exits per revision; whether before 0/8, entry_ok 0 and after 8/8, entry_ok 1 hold.

items.name: MutC1Forgery
items.prompt:
# Target
The C1 counter against forged envelope sets (wave-1 critic C1Sizing named them).
# Work
In a sandbox clone at the tip commit, build commits that (a) replace each copy envelope with its base envelope, (b) use one run three times, (c) swap analyze and inspect files, (d) reuse the L1 probe envelope as inspect-binary-layout base; run the counter on each.
# Acceptance
Mutant table with counter results; say which forgeries it accepts (false accepts) and which verdict each would change.

# Acceptance
